document: MealUp — C6.2 Visual Source Board Audit

coverage.important_note: Board presence is only source coverage. It does not mean the extracted asset is approved, production-ready, or morphologically exact.

reason: Board contains a group of olives rather than one isolated olive.
Individual olive is too small in the board for safe master extraction at final Food Object quality without testing.
The three separately supplied olive-container images are not valid substitutes: they depict a stylized container-like olive with a red inserted element, not a single whole green olive.
olive.recommended_next_step: Attempt high-quality extraction from the board candidate only if the crop survives resolution/edge inspection; otherwise spend one generation on the C6.2-B01 brief.

production_strategy.rule: Use board candidates first; generate only when the board source fails quality or exact-shape review.
production_strategy.generation_policy: Do not consume image generations for assets that can be extracted cleanly from the supplied boards.
